scenes.title: Douk Audio: 3 things to know
scenes.say: Thinking about a Douk Audio amp? Here are three things to know first.

scenes.title: "300W×2" is a maximum
scenes.say: One. Three hundred watts is the chip's maximum. The best-selling A5 is rated seventy eight watts per channel with its included adapter.

scenes.title: Returns need approval
bullets: Change of mind: likely your cost
scenes.say: Two. Returns need approval within thirty days, must ship back within a week, and if you change your mind you'll likely pay shipping.

scenes.title: Warranty and duties
scenes.say: Three, the good part. Douk lists a twenty four month warranty, includes duties at checkout, and its best sellers rate four point four to four point eight stars.

scenes.title: Great value, read the specs
scenes.say: Lots of hi-fi for the money. Just read the real power specs. Full review on WiseChoice K R dot com.
